yif434:269: The solution fully delegates the control plane—tenant scheduling, health monitoring, scaling, etc.—to Lambda + DynamoDB + EventBridge, achieving truly serverless operations. This design pushes control plane cost near zero (no overhead when no API calls are made) while leveraging AWS-native availability and scalability. In contrast, the data plane (Host Agent) only handles local VM lifecycle and status reporting, decoupled from the control plane via DynamoDB. This separation allows the control plane to scale statelessly (multiple Lambda functions processing tenant requests concurrently), while the data plane executes operations asynchronously via SSM Run Command. No direct network communication is needed between the two layers, greatly reducing architectural complexity.
